name: soak_24h
description: Twenty-four hours of continuous input with periodic route switches and macro runs. This is the scenario that finds the leak, the counter that wraps and the queue that slowly fills - none of which a short run can see.
requires: A keyboard and a mouse attached
PC1 and PC2 both able to log for 24 hours
on_this_rig: Opened with --phase baseline and finished a day later with --phase measure against the same state file. A measure phase taken sooner than the 24 hours the scenario names records every check as unmeasured and prints the elapsed hours, so the soak cannot be passed on an afternoon of evidence. After 24 hours it decides error_counters_stable and the three latency and stall checks from counters scoped to the run by the baseline. no_watchdog_reset stays unmeasured - the firmware counts resets but GET_DIAGNOSTICS does not carry the count - and no_stuck_keys needs a logger at each computer. The runner does not perform the write_config step, so the profiles and the macro the scenario describes have to be on the device already.

steps.note: two profiles, a toggle binding, and one macro long enough to be stopped mid-run

checks.no_watchdog_reset: the watchdog count did not change over 24 hours
checks.keyboard_p95_within_budget: keyboard latency p95 <= 20 ms across the whole run
checks.mouse_p95_within_budget: mouse latency p95 <= 20 ms across the whole run
checks.no_gap_over_50ms: no observed pause longer than 50 ms
checks.error_counters_stable: SPI CRC errors and timeouts did not grow
